sourceAnchors.claim: selectscenario requires a scenario folder marker/main file named like the scenario, opens the Scenario resource file, counts RLMZ resources, loads or creates Data Solids, and optionally loads Data Spell.
setupnewgame copies authored source files into runtime caches and reads five startup int32 fields plus two 20-byte code segments from the marker/main scenario file.
usercheck2 reads a Str255 creator/user name from marker/main offset 60.
party selection reads reclevel and maxlevel from the marker/main file and displays them as recommended/required level and maximum level.
loadcontact reads one Data CI contactdata struct.
contactdata is eighteen Str255 fields, producing a 4608-byte Data CI file.
restrictinfo is one 320-byte Data RI record with description, maxpc, maxlevel, banned race flags, and banned caste flags.
party selection opens optional Data RI and reads one restrictinfo record.

fields.name: reclevel
fields.meaning: party level target used by party selection

fields.name: maxlevel
fields.meaning: maximum total party level; 999 can display as None

fields.name: landlevel
fields.meaning: initial outdoor land level loaded by setupnewgame

fields.name: creatorUser
fields.meaning: Divine/user check string; empty allows access

fields.name: trailingBytes
fields.meaning: preserve-only until Divinity writer evidence explains 320-byte files

fields.name: maxpc
fields.meaning: maximum party character count; zero means no extra limit

fields.name: maxlevel
fields.meaning: maximum candidate level gate; zero means no extra limit

fields.name: canrace
fields.meaning: nonzero flags ban race id index+1

fields.name: cancaste
fields.meaning: nonzero flags ban caste id index+1
